name: feature-grid
description: Responsive feature list for a marketing page: a section heading plus a real <ul> of icon + title + description items. Composition only: zero JavaScript, no controller, no reactive directives. Column count is data-cols on the root (2|3|4) and follows grid's mobile-first semantics: it names the WIDEST count, reached at the lg floor, with two columns from sm and one on a phone — all in pure CSS.

heading.description: Section heading. Give it an id and point the section's aria-labelledby at it

description.description: Optional intro paragraph under the heading

items.description: The grid container. Keep it a <ul> so the features are announced as a list; the marker is removed in CSS, not the semantics

item.description: One feature — repeat this element once per feature. Direct child of items

icon.description: Tinted plate WRAPPING a nested data-ui='icon' (the plate is never the icon itself). Mark the plate aria-hidden='true' — it is decoration; the meaning is carried by item-title

item-title.description: Feature name. One level below the section heading so the outline never skips

item-description.description: One or two sentences describing the feature

footer.description: Closing action row under the grid. Nested buttons/links go directly inside and must not carry a data-part

required_attrs: aria-labelledby on the section pointing at the heading id
aria-hidden='true' on every decorative item icon
item titles are real headings one level below the section heading

keyboard.Tab: move through any links inside the items and the footer, in source order

templates.html:
{heading}

{description}

  • {item_title}

    {item_description}

notes: The grid itself is pattern CSS, not a nested data-ui='grid': a nested component would take ownership of the data-part on its children, so [data-part='item'] would no longer belong to feature-grid. Column count is expressed with the grid primitive's own data-cols vocabulary instead.
Nested primitives that carry their own data-variant (buttons in the footer) must not also carry a data-part.

The icon plate wraps the icon primitive instead of being it: an icon renders its glyph with background-color:currentColor behind a CSS mask, so setting a background on a data-ui='icon' element repaints the glyph in that colour rather than framing it. Style the wrapper; let the icon inherit colour and size.
`faqir scaffold landing-page` copies the block between the <!-- @ui:scaffold landing-page --> markers in feature-grid.html verbatim.

changes.note: The responsive ladder moves onto the breakpoint canon, mobile-first (task 0.8-09). The sheet's max-width media blocks became min-width floors on canon tiers (sm 40rem/640px, md 48rem/768px, lg 64rem/1024px), so every unconditional rule is now the PHONE case and a tier block only ever widens it. The item grid follows grid's mobile-first semantics (0.8-04): data-cols names the WIDEST count, reached at lg, with two columns from sm and one on a phone. The floors keep their values, so the only behavioural shift is at exactly a floor: 1024px now gets the wide layout rather than the narrow one.
